key_insight: HSVDQuant turns W4A4 PTQ into a coupled optimization problem, using a deflated Hessian and activation-noise surrogate to make rank-4 low-rank compensation much more effective.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical path to faster, lower-rank quantization of diffusion transformers and LLMs without sacrificing, and often improving, accuracy or image quality.
method: Model weight error as a low-bit residual plus a high-precision low-rank branch.
Eliminate the output-side low-rank factor to obtain a deflated Hessian that downweights errors already explained by the low-rank term.
Add an activation-noise surrogate so the calibration also suppresses 4-bit activation quantization error.
evidence_signal: Across five diffusion backbones, rank-4 HSVDQuant beats rank-4 SVDQuant on PSNR and LPIPS, and it even surpasses rank-32 SVDQuant on several models with up to 6.25× faster quantization; on Qwen3-8B, MMLU rises from 61.50% to 68.17%.
watch_item: Performance depends on careful calibration and solving the coupled objective, so implementation complexity and sensitivity to calibration data may matter in practice.
paper_title: Deflating the Hessian: Rank-4 W4A4 Quantization for Multimodal Diffusion Transformers
